title: Identifying Antihepatocellular Carcinoma Compounds in Gansui Banxia Decoction Using Live Cell Adsorption.
authors: Huang, Jiahao; Mao, Hongyu; Wu, Weidong; Jiang, Siliang; Chen, Lanru; Ma, Tianyu; Zhai, Chunmei; Meng, Yonghai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方中抗肝癌活性成分的筛选与验证，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: PURPOSE: Gansui Banxia Decoction (GSBXD) is a traditional Chinese medicine formula for the treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Preliminary studies have identified the constituents and anticancer efficacy of GSBXD, but there is a gap in the screening of its lead compounds. Using live cell affinity combined with solid-phase extraction (LCA-SPE) and virtual screening and in vitro activity assays, we obtained 14 reliable potential lead compounds. METHODS: Coculturing H22 mouse HCC cells with GSBXD ethanol extract, isolating and purifying the bioactive fractions using LCA-SPE, and identifying the unknown bioactive components by ultraperformance liquid chromatography coupled with quadrupole time-of-flight full information tandem mass spectrometry (UPLC-QTOF-MS(E)) with the UNIFI information processing platform were performed. Network pharmacology and molecular docking techniques predicted the potential mechanisms of these compounds against HCC. The enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay was used to examine the effects of core compounds on the expression of p53 and Bcl-2 in vitro. RESULTS: Fourteen compounds screened from GSBXD using SPE-LCA-UPLC-QTOF-MS(E) may be the main bioactive components. Network pharmacology predictions suggested that protein kinases regulate Bcl-2 and p53 expression to trigger the apoptosis in cancer cells. Molecular docking identified three core compounds, namely, lactiflorin, schaftoside, and violanthin, which showed high affinities for the relevant proteins. Experimental verification confirmed their superior anticancer activity in vitro. Their anti-HCC effects likely involved in the upregulation of p53 and downregulation of Bcl-2 expression at the cellular level. CONCLUSION: We developed a stable and accurate SPE-LCA method, which successfully isolated and characterized 14 potentially active compounds from GSBXD. They may improve HCC by promoting p53 expression and reducing Bcl-2 expression. This work lays a foundation for discovering lead compounds and exploring potential mechanisms in traditional Chinese medicine formulas.
abstract_zh: 目的：甘遂半夏汤（GSBXD）是一种用于治疗肝细胞癌（HCC）的中药方剂。初步研究已鉴定出GSBXD的组成成分及其抗癌功效，但在其先导化合物筛选方面存在空白。通过活细胞亲和结合固相萃取（LCA-SPE）、虚拟筛选及体外活性测定，我们获得了14种可靠的潜在先导化合物。方法：将H22小鼠肝癌细胞与GSBXD乙醇提取物共培养，利用LCA-SPE分离纯化生物活性组分，并通过超高效液相色谱-四极杆飞行时间全信息串联质谱（UPLC-QTOF-MS(E)）结合UNIFI信息处理平台鉴定未知生物活性成分。网络药理学和分子对接技术预测了这些化合物对抗HCC的潜在机制。采用酶联免疫吸附试验检测核心化合物对p53和Bcl-2表达的影响。结果：通过SPE-LCA-UPLC-QTOF-MS(E)从GSBXD中筛选出的14种化合物可能是主要生物活性成分。网络药理学预测表明，蛋白激酶调节Bcl-2和p53表达以触发癌细胞凋亡。分子对接鉴定出三种核心化合物，即芍药苷、夏佛塔苷和维奥兰辛，它们与相关蛋白具有高亲和力。实验验证证实了它们在体外具有优越的抗癌活性。其抗HCC效应可能涉及细胞水平上p53表达上调和Bcl-2表达下调。结论：我们开发了一种稳定且准确的SPE-LCA方法，成功从GSBXD中分离并表征了14种潜在活性化合物。它们可能通过促进p53表达和减少Bcl-2表达来改善HCC。这项工作为发现中药方剂中的先导化合物和探索潜在机制奠定了基础。
